providers.title: Structure of the relative bicentralizer
providers.scope: B(N in M, phi) is a sigma-invariant von Neumann subalgebra containing N' cap M, contained in N_phi' cap M, meeting N in B(N, phi), with a unique phi-preserving faithful normal expectation.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform modulus
providers.scope: For a in B(N in M, phi) and eps > 0 there is delta > 0 with ||[a, y]||# <= eps for contractions y in N with ||[y, phi]|| <= delta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bottom factors of type III_1
providers.scope: If N is a type III_1 factor with separable predual, E(b) = phi(E(b)) 1 for b in B and E_B(x) = phi(x) 1 for x in N.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Averaging and killing
providers.scope: E_B is a limit of finite averages of conjugations by unitaries almost commuting with phi, and every z with E_B(z) = 0 is moved by a unitary of the asymptotic centralizer by at least ||z||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Transition isomorphisms
providers.scope: Unitary sequences moving phi to psi conjugate B(phi) onto B(psi) by a state-compatible isomorphism independent of the sequence.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The relative bicentralizer flow
providers.scope: Admissible lambda-families give a u-continuous phi-preserving action beta of R_+^* on B(phi), commuting with the modular group and fixing N' cap M (Ando-Haagerup-Houdayer-Marrakchi).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A state-independent algebra
providers.scope: N v B(N in M, phi) does not depend on phi.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matrix amplifications
providers.scope: B(N in M, tau_R (x) chi_1) = 1 (x) B(N_1 in M_1, chi_1) for N = R (x) N_1, M = R (x) M_1 with R a matrix algebra.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Binormal states of a finite algebra
providers.scope: A binormal state of B(K) for a finite algebra Q in its trace representation is a limit of vector states of vectors almost of the form Y(1 (x) eta) with uniformly bounded Y in A_F (x) Q.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bounded approximating vectors
providers.scope: A binormal state of B(L^2(M)) at modular energy zero is a limit of vector states of vectors almost of the form y(1 (x) xi) with uniformly bounded y in A_F (x) M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The binormal identity (Marrakchi)
providers.scope: A state with the two marginals of phi o E, Phi(e_N) = 1 and modular energy zero satisfies Phi(a rho(b)) = <a xi b, xi> for a in B(N in M, phi), b in M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Approximate eigenoperators
providers.scope: ||sigma_t(v) - e^{its} v||_phi^2 + e^{-s} ||(sigma_t(v) - e^{its} v)*||_phi^2 <= 512 (1+|t|)^2 ||v|| ||v phi - e^{-s} phi v||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Modular frequency
providers.scope: v phi = e^{-s} phi v if and only if sigma_t(v) = e^{its} v for all t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The zero-shift map (Marrakchi)
providers.scope: A ucp map zeta of B(L^2(M)) fixing e_N, bimodular over N', with zeta = E_B on M and zeta(f(log Delta)) = f(log Delta).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spectral shift maps (Marrakchi)
providers.scope: For every s a ucp map theta_s fixing e_N, bimodular over N', with theta_s = gamma_s o E_B on M and theta_s(f(log Delta)) = f(log Delta - s).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Binormal identity at frequency s
providers.scope: A state with the marginals of phi o E, Phi(e_N) = 1 and modular energy s satisfies Phi(gamma_s(a) rho(b)) = <a xi b, xi>.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The two relative products
providers.scope: x Omega (x) a Omega -> xa Omega and -> ax Omega extend to isometries R, L of L^2(N) (x) L^2(B) into L^2(M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exact eigenoperators
providers.scope: On an eigenoperator x of frequency h, U = L*R acts as the flow W_h on the second factor and agrees with D = exp(iX (x) Y).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The iterated kernel (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every word in U and flow shifts has a ucp map Z with marginals phi, Z(e_N) = 1, Z(f(log Delta)) = f(S_n + d), whose coefficients give the word.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spectral transfer
providers.scope: A band-limited element with bound L maps the spectral subspace of log Delta for an interval J into that for its closed L-neighbourhood.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform energy estimate (OpenAI)
providers.scope: ||(C - D_all)(xi (x) eta)|| <= eps_eta(delta) ||xi|| for all words, shifts and xi with total modular energy in an interval of length delta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hybrid and averaged words
providers.scope: The same estimate holds when some U_j are replaced by D_j or all by (U_j + D_j)/2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Time averaging
providers.scope: Integrated against a probability density p_delta in time, the squared error is at most eps_eta(delta)^2 ||xi||^2, with no spectral restriction.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: U = D (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The comparison contraction L*R of the two relative products equals exp(iX (x) Y); equivalently R = LD.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The algebra N v B
providers.scope: L^2(N v B) = L(L^2(N) (x) L^2(B)); there B acts on the second factor and N as D(N (x) 1)D*.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Relative commutants in the core
providers.scope: For Q_0 fixed by the modular group, Q_0' cap c(M) = (Q_0' cap M) rtimes R.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The core flow
providers.scope: The relative bicentralizer flow extends to B rtimes R by gamma_s(lambda(t)) = e^{-ist} lambda(t).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Core fixed point theorem (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Fixed points of the core flow on B rtimes R commute with N.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Criterion for subalgebras
providers.scope: A modular-invariant P in N whose centralizer has relative commutant in M inside B and which contains complete eigen-rows for a dense set of frequencies has P' cap c(M) = N' cap c(M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Induced expectations and state changes
providers.scope: For a matrix subalgebra F with matrix units diagonalizing psi_F: E_F is a faithful normal expectation onto F' cap M; rho o E_F = rho iff f_ij rho = (h_j/h_i) rho f_ij; ||rho o E_F - rho|| <= k max ||f_ij rho - (h_j/h_i) rho f_ij||.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One unitary reduces the remainder
providers.scope: If rho o E_T = rho for a matrix subalgebra T with its trace and u in T is unitary, then ||E_T(z)||_rho^2 <= ||z||_rho^2 - ||uzu* - z||_rho^2 / 4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Completing a partial isometry
providers.scope: In a countably decomposable type III factor, a partial isometry under nonzero projections p, q is close to one from p onto q, with the distance controlled by the defects.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matrix units with a prescribed ratio
providers.scope: In a type III_1 factor with separable predual, for lambda > 0 there are 2x2 matrix units with ||[e, phi]|| <= delta and ||x phi - lambda phi x|| <= delta; replacing phi by its product with omega_lambda moves it by at most 2 max(1, 1/lambda) delta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Lifting matrix units
providers.scope: A unital *-homomorphism M_k -> N_{phi,omega}, N a countably decomposable type III factor, lifts to unital *-homomorphisms M_k -> N whose sequences asymptotically commute with phi.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Dyadic approximation
providers.scope: Every unitary of a II_1 factor is within delta in 2-norm of a unitary of a subalgebra isomorphic to M_{2^p}.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One step
providers.scope: Given z with E_B(z) = 0, a matrix subalgebra M_{2^p} with its trace and an eigen part (M_2, omega_mu) (x) (M_2, omega_nu) move the state by at most eps and give ||E_T(z)||^2 <= 15/16 ||z||^2 + eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The tracial part and N v B
providers.scope: The relative commutant in M of the tracial part T is contained in N v B(N in M, phi).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exchangeability
providers.scope: The centralizer of the product state on the infinite tensor power G has trivial relative commutant in G (an operator-algebraic Hewitt-Savage law).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Injective subalgebras preserving core commutants (OpenAI; bottom factors of type III_1)
providers.scope: N in M with separable preduals and expectation, N a factor of type III_1: for every faithful normal state phi and eta in (0, 1] there are a faithful normal state psi with ||psi - phi|| <= eta and an approximately finite-dimensional, sigma^psi-invariant P in N with P_psi' cap N = C, P_psi' cap M in B(N in M, psi) and P' cap c(M) = N' cap c(M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irreducible centralizers (Haagerup)
providers.scope: In a factor of type III_1 with separable predual the faithful normal states psi with N_psi' cap N = C are norm dense in the normal states.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Centralizer criterion
providers.scope: If P in N is sigma^phi-invariant, P_phi' cap M is contained in N_phi' cap M, and N is generated by N_phi and P, then P' cap c(M) = N' cap c(M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hyperfinite subfactors with the same relative commutant (Popa)
providers.scope: N a II_1 factor, N in M with separable preduals and expectation: commuting matrix subalgebras T_n of N generate T with T' cap M = N' cap M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Type II_infinity bottom factors
providers.scope: For N of type II_infinity and the state phi = sum_i 2^-i tau_0(x_ii) there is a sigma^phi-invariant AFD P in N with P' cap M = N' cap M and P' cap c(M) = N' cap c(M).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Injective subalgebras preserving core commutants (semifinite bottom factors)
providers.scope: N in M with separable preduals and expectation, N a semifinite factor: there is an AFD P in N with expectation, P' cap c(M) = N' cap c(M) and P' cap M = N' cap M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
